demo.title: private-swap.txt
demo.code:
You: swap 0.0001 ETH on Base to USDC privately, to my own address
Agent: asks for the refund address, then shows the quote
       You send 0.0001 ETH, you receive the quoted USDC, with a minimum and a time estimate
       Send it?
You: yes
Agent: sends the exact amount to the one-time deposit address,
       tracks the status, then confirms the USDC balance

setup: Install the skill into your Bankr agent
Have a wallet with the token you want to sell on its chain
Ask your agent for a private swap and name the tokens, the amount, a refund address and a receiving address
Approve the quote the agent shows before it sends anything
